status: Authorized design exploration; specified before fitting this experiment
interpretation: Historical development comparison; these years have already informed design choices
confirmation: No untouched confirmation sample certified. 2023 has 72 missing input sessions and prior predictions; no 2023 scoring in this experiment.
validation_scheme: Same single chronological validation block as the previous study; no new folds or near-tie rule
feature_sets_description: C; C plus sentiment and attention; C plus sentiment, attention,384 embeddings and2 agreement measures
global_penalty_grid: Unchanged protocol_linear.grid_specification; exact source and grid recorded at launch

group_ridge.off_candidates: Explicitly exclude social and/or entire text block; retain exact smaller-model candidates
group_ridge.groups: C includes17 controls and17 missingness flags; S is sentiment and attention; T includes embedding coordinates or PCs plus2 agreement measures

representations.pca: For characteristics_textcore only; dimension selected among16,32,64,128 on validation jointly with other settings
representations.pca_fit: Equal-date covariance of fitting-scaled384 embedding coordinates using eligible input rows without outcome conditioning; no whitening before PCA; component scores subsequently fitting-standardized
representations.agreement_measures: Retained separately from PCA and assigned to the text penalty group
representations.final_refit: Re-estimate all fitted scaling and PCA transformations on the final fitting rows

refit_policies.retain: Keep selected coefficients and transformations estimated before validation
refit_policies.recent: Refit using latest selected F exchange-session signal dates with matured labels before the test month
refit_policies.union: Refit using the union of original fitting and validation input rows; F+126 sessions; preserve original boundary exclusions

penalty_transfer: Carry selected ridge alpha/group multipliers; for lasso/enet carry alpha_fraction and l1_ratio, recomputing alpha_max on final fitting data
selection: Highest mean daily validation Spearman IC, first declared candidate within existing numerical tie tolerance; no test-period model selection
baseline_reproduction: Verify all12 retained fixed504 full-input global forecasts per target against the preceding characteristic checkpoints
